info.title: Tiny Toons Looniversity
info.synopsis: La serie segue le avventure della Nonna, in veste di detective, che viaggia per il mondo risolvendo dei misteri accompagnata dal trio composto da Silvestro, Titti e il cane Ettore.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: It's the first day of school at Acme Looniversity. Babs and Buster Bunny meet their new friends, Sweetie Bird, Hamton J. Pig, and Plucky Duck.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Rivals Buster and Plucky decide to throw an epic pizza party and are shocked to find out they're actually getting along while Babs and Sweetie get into their first roommate disagreement.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Babs realizes Acme Loo's school paper has closed so she starts a new one with her pal Sweetie. But when Plucky starts a gossipy tabloid to compete against them, which paper will come out on top?

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Buster and Sweetie join the Tooney Ball team during Electives Week while Babs and Plucky tackle the basics in Anvils 101, leaving Hamton on a journey to fix his indecisiveness.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Buster meets his nemesis, Montana Max, and must apply a new lesson from Bugs about drag to keep the Loo Bru from demolition.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: It's Prank Week at Acme Loo and our pals get into escalating shenanigans trying to out prank their rival, Aqua Loo.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Hamton gets into medical school but soon realizes it's not at all what he imagined. Buster desperately tries to find a way to bring his pal back to Acme Loo.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Babs and Buster are excited to get college jobs, but can they stand the heat cooking for the school chef?

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Buster finds a cloning machine at Wile E. Coyote's yard sale that he uses to make another Buster, Babs and Sweetie snag a time machine that they use to open a vintage clothing store.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Babs is excited to be the first student director of the annual toon showcase, but she quickly learns it won't be easy as she thought. Meanwhile, with the help of his friends, Hamton learns to shine in the spotlight.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Babs is drawn into the world of modeling by animal calendar photographer, Elmyra Duff, while Plucky grapples with a bad caricature.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: It's picture day at Acme Loo! Babs accidentally shrinks herself, Buster fails to get the perfect photo day haircut, Plucky gives lessons on being direct, and Hamton struggles to find his photo persona.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: The toons take Marvin the Martian's class, and head to space. Buster tries to cheer up a homesick Babs, Plucky searches for a space outfit, and Sweetie is too obsessed with a video game to notice any of it - even when the aliens attack!

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Babs and Buster attend a twin convention but are soon ostracized for not being exactly the same. Hamton accidentally becomes famous, and Plucky steps up as his manager. And Sweetie won't let anything stop her from finishing her board game.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Buster, Plucky e Hampton si uniscono a una società segreta esclusiva, ma presto si rendono conto che i benefici promessi non valgono i sacrifici richiesti.

translations.value: Buster, Plucky e Hampton si uniscono a una società segreta esclusiva, ma presto si rendono conto che i benefici promessi non valgono i sacrifici richiesti.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Buster è un coniglio fortunato... fino a quando non lo è più. Quando la sua fortuna finisce, mette a rischio la chiusura di Acme Loo.

translations.value: Buster è un coniglio fortunato... fino a quando non lo è più. Quando la sua fortuna finisce, mette a rischio la chiusura di Acme Loo.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: During a camping trip, Sweetie admits she's afraid of something in the woods, and after a round of scary stories, everyone finds out what's out there.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: It's student council elections at Acme Loo! Babs and Buster both run for President.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Plucky is named ruler of a kingdom, and the toons visit his castle as he ascends the throne.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Sweetie competes in a cat vs. bird competition but faces pressure to win at all costs.

episodes.name: Un divertente weekend di paura
episodes.plot: E' Halloween, ma Baby e Lindon hanno i nervi a fior di pelle e si spaventano per tutto. Melody vince un soggiorno gratis in una fattoria.

translations.value: E' Halloween, ma Baby e Lindon hanno i nervi a fior di pelle e si spaventano per tutto. Melody vince un soggiorno gratis in una fattoria.

episodes.name: Tiny Toons Looniversity: Tesori e fiocchi di neve
episodes.plot: Buster e' un coniglio fortunatissimo, cosa che gli permette di far nevicare fuori stagione e annullare un esame per cui Duca non era preparato.

translations.overview: La serie segue le avventure della Nonna, in veste di detective, che viaggia per il mondo risolvendo dei misteri accompagnata dal trio composto da Silvestro, Titti e il cane Ettore.
Follow Babs and Buster Bunny, Sweetie Bird, Hamton J. Pig, and Plucky Duck as they learn what it takes to be a professional toon.
